Nora (marketing): Quick huddle — community refapp blog went live at 10:05 PT. Early signals good. Proposal: gated technical appendix + 1-hour 'playbook' webinar to capture engineer leads.
Diego (devrel): Nice. Numbers so far?
Nora (marketing): 8h: 2.7k pageviews, 180 newsletter signups, 9 repo clones, 5 demo requests.
Liam (growth): Demo requests? company size or origin?
Vera (content): 7 startups, 2 mid-market. Most signups via inline CTA.
lead-router: 2 leads failed routing: missing "utm_medium" -> sent to manual-review.
Priya (ops): Can default missing utm_medium -> "organic" and tag 'auto-defaulted' for SDR visibility. I'll run reprocess after staging smoke.
Diego (devrel): Also, please add a short bench clarification in the post. Current latency numbers were single-request (batch=1). Add note: batching increases throughput; see appendix for configs.
Vera (content): I'll insert a bolded bench callout and two CTA variants: Variant A "Register for the playbook webinar" Variant B "Grab the repo + appendix".
Liam (growth): Recommend A/B test CTAs and route downloads -> demo funnel. Budget: $500 initial dev promo.
Nora (marketing): Action items:
- Vera: update post copy + add CTAs (EOD)
- Priya: patch routing default + reprocess leads today
- Diego: draft webinar agenda + confirm Rafael for runtime section (tomorrow)
- Liam: build reg page + promo setup (48h)
Priya (ops): Reprocess command I'll run after prod deploy:
```bash
python infra/reprocess_leads.py --filter "missing_utm_medium" --assign default:organic --tag auto-defaulted
```
Diego (devrel): Proposed agenda: 10m intro, 25m hands-on demo, 15m benchmarks & ops notes, 10m Q&A. Rafael to cover runtime tuning.
Vera (content): I'll post the updated copy and CTA variants here when ready. Bold bench note so readers don't misread single-request latency as production throughput.
Nora (marketing): Thanks team 680 Please update this thread when items are complete so SDRs can pick up leads.
